title: CHAL: Council of Hierarchical Agentic Language
reasoning: The paper's architecture (CHAL) explicitly incorporates ethical systems (e.g., Utilitarianism, Deontology, Virtue Ethics) and epistemic personas (including a 'Supernaturalist' persona representing religious/faith-based worldviews) as configurable hyperparameters. It evaluates how these value systems and religious/philosophical commitments shape the reasoning and adjudication outcomes of LLM agents in multi-agent debates.
